ops.title: Wallet
ops.lede: Search member wallet accounts, review balances and history, and post manual credits, debits, or reversals.
ops.noAccounts: No wallet accounts found for this member.
ops.confirmCreditDescription: This posts a credit to the selected member wallet account. The action is recorded with your operator identity.
ops.confirmDebitDescription: This posts a debit from the selected member wallet account. Insufficient funds will be rejected.
ops.confirmReverseDescription: This posts a reversal for the selected transaction. Reversals cannot be undone from this screen.
ops.mutationReplaySuccess: Request replayed — the original mutation was already posted.
ops.errorMemberUserIdInvalid: Enter a valid member user ID (UUID).
ops.errorInsufficientFunds: Insufficient wallet balance for this debit.
ops.errorIdempotencyConflict: Idempotency conflict — change the request or wait and retry with a new submission.
ops.errorReasonRequired: A reason is required for every wallet mutation.
ops.errorAmountInvalid: Enter a positive whole-number amount in minor units.
ops.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to manage wallet operations.
ops.errorValidation: Check the form values and try again.
